coverage.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN source='e7_farside_test' THEN 'test_seam' WHEN entry_time<:era THEN 'pre_aug15' WHEN plan_id='UNRESOLVABLE' THEN 'UNRESOLVABLE' WHEN pnl_corrected IS NULL THEN 'null_pnl' ELSE 'eligible' END category,COUNT(*) n,GROUP_CONCAT(id) ids FROM trader_positions GROUP BY category

ack.label: ack census is current at audit, not historical visibility
ack.sql: SELECT level,COUNT(*) n,SUM(acked=1) acked,GROUP_CONCAT(id) ids FROM day_plan_alerts GROUP BY level

mae.label: MAE coverage post Aug15 including exclusions for inventory only
mae.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) n,SUM(mae IS NOT NULL AND mfe IS NOT NULL) covered,GROUP_CONCAT(id) ids FROM trader_positions WHERE entry_time>=:era
